"Love Travel" is a blog jointly run by Anya and Wendy Love Travelogue is a travel journal that Anya and Wendy started writing in 2008. Over time, it has evolved into an accommodation information station for Japan, South Korea, Thailand, Vietnam, and Taiwan, with tens of thousands of people consulting and booking accommodations every day. Over the years, we have visited hundreds of hotels, collaborated with organizations such as the Japan Tourism Agency, the Tourism Authority of Thailand, and Tigerair Taiwan, and accompanied more than 1000 million readers to find "the most worthwhile place to stay on this trip". Formerly a Yahoo! Travel blogger and a finalist for the Global Chinese Blog Awards, she now runs a Thailand travel group with 5.9 members, continuously finding inspiration on the road and sharing it with you. Wendy Despite having a science and engineering background, he's an artsy young man with a passion for film and history. By day, he analyzes trends in the 3C industry; by night, he experiences life as a play in the cinema; and while traveling, he enjoys rediscovering each city from a historical perspective. He currently runs a movie channel with 1.6 subscribers and is also responsible for writing travelogues about attractions, itineraries, and hotels. Cooperation project Since 2011, we have been invited to participate in more than 15 official and brand collaboration interview projects with organizations such as the Japan Tourism Agency, the Tourism Authority of Thailand, Tigerair Taiwan, and the Philippine Tourism Authority, covering locations including Hokkaido, Kyushu, Chiang Mai, Phuket, and Manila.
